proposed_line_text: L90: **Subtype/state-head span extension.** When a Specific Disease name is the complement of an “of”-phrase, the governing noun is a subtype or state noun (a noun denoting a variety, stage, type, or form of a condition, or a deficiency state), and that governing noun carries an adjectival, ordinal, or numeric premodifier, the span runs from the first character of that premodifier through the end of the disease name. The premodifier narrows the most specific form of the disease, so it belongs to the minimum span. Determiners such as “a” or “the” do not count as premodifiers for this purpose.
